## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!split` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "currency": "IDR",
  "locale": "id-ID",
  "roundTo": 100
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --muted: #5b5380; --hint: #776b99; --edge: #f2d5a6; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe9c2, var(--cream) 55%); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px; }
  .lbl { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
  .head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  #code { padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); }
  #code:empty { display: none; }
  input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 800 20px system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0 12px; height: 44px; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--edge); transition: border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  input:focus { border-color: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--orange); }
  input::placeholder { color: var(--hint); font-weight: 600; }
  button { border: 0; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; font: 800 14px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #d99a12; transition: transform .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease; }
  button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #d99a12; }
  button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .chips { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) 1.7fr; gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 3px; }
  .chip { height: 38px; padding: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0b0720; transform: translateY(2px); animation: pop .22s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes pop { 50% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(1.08); } }
  .custom { position: relative; }
  .custom input { height: 38px; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 20px 0 10px; }
  .custom.on input { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0b0720; }
  .custom i { position: absolute; right: 9px; top: 11px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); pointer-events: none; }
  .custom.on i { color: var(--yellow); }
  .people { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
  .stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 3px; }
  .stepper button { width: 40px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c9621f; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
  .stepper button:active:not(:disabled) { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c9621f; }
  .stepper button:disabled { background: #eadfce; color: var(--hint); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #d8c9b3; cursor: default; }
  #count { min-width: 44px; text-align: center; font: 800 20px system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .result { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(115deg, var(--orange), var(--yellow)); border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px 14px 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #d9661d; }
  .result .lbl { color: var(--ink); }
  .result::after { content: '🍕'; position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 6px; font-size: 20px; transform: rotate(14deg); }
  #each { font: 800 34px/1.15 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; margin: 1px 0 3px; }
  #each.empty { opacity: .55; }
  .total { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  #totalLabel { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #note { margin: -1px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { button, input { transition: none; } .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { animation: none; } }
</style>
<div>
  <div class="head"><label class="lbl" for="bill">Bill amount</label><span class="lbl" id="code"></span></div>
  <input id="bill" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="done" placeholder="0">
</div>
<div role="group" aria-labelledby="tipLabel">
  <div class="head"><span class="lbl" id="tipLabel">Tip</span></div>
  <div class="chips">
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-tip="0">0%</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-tip="5">5%</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-tip="10">10%</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-tip="15">15%</button>
    <span class="custom" id="customWrap"><input id="tipCustom" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="done" placeholder="Other" aria-label="Custom tip percent"><i>%</i></span>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="people">
  <span class="lbl" id="peopleLabel">People</span>
  <div class="stepper" role="group" aria-labelledby="peopleLabel">
    <button type="button" id="minus" aria-label="One person fewer">−</button>
    <span id="count">2</span>
    <button type="button" id="plus" aria-label="One person more">+</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="result" aria-live="polite">
  <span class="lbl">Each person pays</span>
  <div id="each">—</div>
  <div class="total"><span id="totalLabel"></span><span id="total"></span></div>
</div>
<p id="note"></p>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = { empty: 'Type the bill amount above', total: 'Total with tip', rounded: 'Rounded up to the nearest ', extra: ' · adds ' };
  var MAX_PEOPLE = 99;
  var cfg = DATA || {};
  var state = { tip: 0, people: 2 };

  var locale = cfg.locale || undefined;
  var money = makeMoney(cfg.currency, locale);
  // Separator the locale uses for decimals, so "10.000" reads as ten thousand in id-ID but "10.5" still reads as 10.5.
  var DECIMAL = decimalChar(locale);
  var roundTo = cfg.roundTo > 0 ? cfg.roundTo : Math.pow(10, -money.digits);

  function makeMoney(currency, loc) {
    try {
      var digits = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency }).resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits;
      return { code: currency, digits: digits, format: function (v, d) {
        d = d === undefined ? digits : d;
        return new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency, minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }).format(v);
      } };
    } catch (e) {
      return { code: '', digits: 2, format: function (v, d) {
        d = d === undefined ? 2 : d;
        return new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }).format(v);
      } };
    }
  }

  function decimalChar(loc) {
    var parts = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc).formatToParts(1.5);
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) if (parts[i].type === 'decimal') return parts[i].value;
    return '.';
  }

  function parseNumber(raw, grouping) {
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      var c = raw.charAt(i);
      if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c === '.' || c === ',') s += c;
    }
    if (!s) return NaN;
    var dot = s.lastIndexOf('.'), comma = s.lastIndexOf(',');
    var sep = '';
    if (dot !== -1 && comma !== -1) sep = dot > comma ? '.' : ',';
    else if (dot !== -1 || comma !== -1) {
      var one = dot !== -1 ? '.' : ',';
      var parts = s.split(one);
      var looksGrouped = parts.length > 2 || (grouping && one !== DECIMAL && parts[1].length === 3);
      sep = looksGrouped ? '' : one;
    }
    var at = sep ? s.lastIndexOf(sep) : s.length;
    var whole = digitsOnly(s.slice(0, at)), frac = digitsOnly(s.slice(at + 1));
    return parseFloat((whole || '0') + '.' + (frac || '0'));
  }

  function formatPercent(v) {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(v) + '%';
  }

  function digitsOnly(s) {
    var out = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) if (s.charAt(i) >= '0' && s.charAt(i) <= '9') out += s.charAt(i);
    return out;
  }

  function split(bill, tipPercent, people, step) {
    var tip = bill * tipPercent / 100;
    var total = bill + tip;
    // Trim float noise (616.0000000001 steps) so it can't push a share up one extra step.
    var each = Math.ceil(Math.round(total / people / step * 1e6) / 1e6) * step;
    return { tip: tip, total: total, each: each, extra: Math.max(0, each * people - total) };
  }

  var billEl = document.getElementById('bill');
  var customEl = document.getElementById('tipCustom');
  var customWrap = document.getElementById('customWrap');
  var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  var eachEl = document.getElementById('each');

  function fit(el, max, min) {
    var size = max;
    el.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
    while (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth && size > min) { size -= 2; el.style.fontSize = size + 'px'; }
  }

  function render() {
    for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
      var on = customEl.value === '' && Number(chips[i].getAttribute('data-tip')) === state.tip;
      chips[i].setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    customWrap.className = 'custom' + (customEl.value !== '' ? ' on' : '');
    document.getElementById('count').textContent = state.people;
    document.getElementById('minus').disabled = state.people <= 1;
    document.getElementById('plus').disabled = state.people >= MAX_PEOPLE;

    var bill = parseNumber(billEl.value, true);
    var stepDigits = roundTo >= 1 ? 0 : money.digits;
    var note = TEXT.rounded + money.format(roundTo, stepDigits);
    if (!(bill > 0)) {
      eachEl.textContent = '—';
      eachEl.className = 'empty';
      document.getElementById('totalLabel').textContent = TEXT.empty;
      document.getElementById('total').textContent = '';
    } else {
      var r = split(bill, state.tip, state.people, roundTo);
      eachEl.textContent = money.format(r.each, stepDigits);
      eachEl.className = '';
      document.getElementById('totalLabel').textContent = TEXT.total + ' (' + formatPercent(state.tip) + ')';
      document.getElementById('total').textContent = money.format(r.total);
      if (r.extra * Math.pow(10, money.digits) >= 0.5) note += TEXT.extra + money.format(r.extra);
    }
    document.getElementById('note').textContent = note;
    fit(eachEl, 34, 18);
  }

  document.getElementById('code').textContent = money.code;
  billEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  customEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var v = parseNumber(customEl.value, false);
    state.tip = v >= 0 ? v : 0;
    render();
  });
  for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
    chips[i].addEventListener('click', function () {
      customEl.value = '';
      state.tip = Number(this.getAttribute('data-tip'));
      render();
    });
  }
  document.getElementById('minus').addEventListener('click', function () { if (state.people > 1) { state.people--; render(); } });
  document.getElementById('plus').addEventListener('click', function () { if (state.people < MAX_PEOPLE) { state.people++; render(); } });
  // The bubble can settle on its final width after the first paint; refit the big number then.
  addEventListener('resize', render);
  // Enter closes the phone keyboard so the result underneath is no longer covered.
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.blur) e.target.blur(); });
  render();
</script>
`

client.command('split', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Bill splitter",
    height: 340,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The bill splitter opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| Input | Phone keyboard, Tap |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
